constraints: The array must already be sorted, and the sort order must match the order parameter ('>' for ascending, '<' for descending); behavior is unspecified if the array isn't actually sorted that way.
Uses a binary search, so it is markedly more efficient on large arrays than Find in array.

overloadMerges.note: posFirst and posLast are documented as out parameters (returned positions/insertion points), not in -- the mechanical draft defaulted every parameter to direction 'in'.

params.name: value
params.description: Value (same type as array) to search for

params.name: order
params.description: '>' if array is sorted ascending, '<' if descending

params.name: posFirst
params.description: Position of the first matching occurrence if found, otherwise the position where value should be inserted

params.name: posLast
params.description: Position of the last matching occurrence if found, otherwise same as posFirst

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns true if at least one element of the sorted array matches value, using a binary search, and optionally returns the first/last matching positions (or insertion point) via posFirst/posLast.
